sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT id FROM orders LIMIT 10

reasons.message: app.orders (as orders) has no provable tenant predicate on orders.tenant_id in the same SELECT
reasons.hint: Add `WHERE orders.tenant_id = $1` as a top-level AND condition inside the same SELECT that reads app.orders (not in an outer query, not under OR/NOT, not in the ON of the preserved side of an outer join).
